name: Bellagio
positioning: Bellagio, a Center Strip resort in Las Vegas inspired by the villages of Europe, overlooking a lake with fountains, with fountain-view rooms and lake-view suites
best_for: Travelers who want a Center Strip base within walking distance of Caesars, Paris and Aria
Guests who want a room or suite with a view of the fountains or the lake

facts.text: Bellagio was inspired by the villages of Europe and overlooks a Mediterranean-blue lake with fountains.
Bellagio sits at Center Strip, directly across from Paris and Caesars, with the fountains as its front yard.
From Bellagio you can walk to Caesars, Paris, Aria, Cosmopolitan and the Shops at Crystals.
Bellagio has a Dale Chihuly glass ceiling.
The Fountain View King, in the Bellagio Tower, has a view of the Fountains of Bellagio.
The Two Bedroom Bellagio Suite is an Italian-inspired residential-style suite.
The One Bedroom Lakeview Suite has views of the lake.
Many Bellagio rooms have fountain views, and bathrooms lean heavily on marble and soaking tubs.
The pool's private cabanas have lounge seating and personal bar service.
Bellagio is home to the aquatic production "O" by Cirque du Soleil.
Carbone Riviera, from Major Food Group, has some tables facing the fountains.
The Pinky Ring by Bruno Mars is a cocktail lounge at Bellagio.

highlights.text: The Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens show floral displays that change with the seasons.
Spa Tower rooms and suites were redesigned by Champalimaud with a Lake Como palette and custom furnishings.
The Bellagio Pool has an Italian-inspired pool courtyard, set among cypress trees and courtyards.
The Bellagio Gallery of Fine Art hosts intimate exhibitions of artists.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes that Bellagio's dining and room rates skew upscale.
WhataHotel notes a busy casino environment with crowds and noise.
Bellagio is part of MGM Rewards, so stays can be combined with other MGM properties across the Strip.
